history.text: The Kingdom of Kongo and Teke states organised the lower Congo region.
Pierre Savorgnan de Brazza signed a treaty with the Teke ruler, founding Brazzaville.
The territory became part of French Equatorial Africa.
Civil conflict returned Denis Sassou Nguesso to power.

worthSeeing.title: Nouabale-Ndoki:
worthSeeing.text: Intact rainforest with gorillas and forest elephants, a UNESCO site.

worthSeeing.title: Odzala-Kokoua:
worthSeeing.text: Forest clearings where lowland gorillas gather.

worthSeeing.title: Brazzaville riverfront:
worthSeeing.text: The Congo River opposite Kinshasa, the closest pair of capitals in the world.
